notes: npmRegistry fields describe the published tarball's own integrity metadata, cross-checked against unpkg at fetch time; they are not a hash of this single extracted file, which unpkg serves out of that same tarball. The sri.integrityAttribute is not applied in widget.html: SRI verification requires a CORS-mode fetch, which file:// (how widget.html is always loaded, by screenshot.sh) cannot perform, so Chrome blocks the script outright rather than skip the check. Re-add it only if this file is ever served over HTTP(S) with crossorigin set on the script tag; verify the vendored file against this digest manually otherwise (e.g. openssl dgst -sha384 -binary codersrank-summary.min.js | openssl base64 -A).
